fields.default_value: Robert Khoubian is an international food-trade executive, entrepreneur and market-intelligence publisher. Since 2004, his work has covered China, Russia and CIS markets, North America, Southeast Asia and regulated food supply chains. His experience includes market development, customs and veterinary requirements, government trade missions, product adaptation, export-credit insurance, cold-chain execution and the development of Aquaprole Group. Robert Khoubian Market Intelligence converts that operating experience into research, reports and decision tools for importers, exporters, institutions and media.
